snapshot.name: Reliance Industries Ltd
snapshot.about: Reliance was founded by Dhirubhai Ambani and is now promoted and managed by his elder son, Mukesh Dhirubhai Ambani. Ambani's family has about 50% shareholding in the conglomerate.

business_mix.what_it_does: Reliance Industries Limited operates across multiple business segments including oil-to-chemicals (O2C), digital services through Jio Platforms, new energy, and retail commerce.

segments.name: O2C
segments.note: Oil-to-chemicals business, led the charge with EBITDA up 68%.

segments.name: Jio Platforms
segments.note: Digital and telecom services, including mobile, home broadband, and enterprise solutions.

segments.name: New Energy
segments.note: Accelerating investments with earnings contribution expected in FY 2028.

segments.name: Retail / Consumer
segments.note: Includes grocery, apparel, footwear, electronics, and omni-channel retail networks.

narrative_vs_numbers.management_says: Management highlights ongoing operational improvements, scale benefits, and future contributions from new energy and quick commerce.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers_say: Sales grew from 231535.0 in Sep 2024 to 330601.0 in Sep 2026, while operating profit moved from 39058.0 to 56616.0 over the same period.

promises.credibility: Management's recent strategic promises are largely long-term or qualitative, leaving most guidance pending or unverifiable from standard financial statements alone.

bull: Latest quarter Sep 2026 showed strong growth with revenue up 30% YoY, EBITDA up 23%, and PAT up 34%.
The 5-yr cumulative CFO is 1.90x PAT, totaling ₹755,290 Cr versus ₹398,016 Cr.
The company generated a 5-yr free cash flow of ₹129,190 Cr, remaining positive in 4 out of 5 years.
bear: Growth is clearly slowing, with the revenue CAGR dropping from 18% over 5 years to 6% over 3 years.
Working capital is stretching as the cash conversion cycle worsened from -3 to 25 days.
ROCE is low at 10.3% and ROE stands at only 8.91%.
